title: Azusawa Kohane — Lemonade Break♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait, Kohane!
We had a lot more customers than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
We still have plenty of time until the doors open for the event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank goodness. That means all we have to do now is meet up with Akito and the others and perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, that reminds me. Do you have any albums with photos of you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I'm sure we do at home somewhere, but what's this all the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You told us that story the other day from when you were little, right? I was hoping to see what you looked like back then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally.
I'll try looking for some when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you so much, An!
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are!
Kohane, over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here you are! These are the albums you asked for the other day!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, this is more than I was expecting! Hang on... One, two... Five?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. I was surprised too.
But you'll see why there are so many once you start flipping through them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? In that case, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Knock yourself out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, here's one with you and Ken. And this one... Is this your mom?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's her!
Also, Aunt Nagi's the one who took this picture.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, you guys all seem so close!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, the next page has photos of Nagi and Taiga. Also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? This man in the hat...
He seems awfully familiar...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, can you guess?
That's actually the manager of the live house from yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The person next to him is the old manager of RED, the live house we performed at the other day. And...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...which is why we have so many albums. There're as many photos of our family as there are of people from around town.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I really had no idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Going through all these albums kinda made me see why Aunt Nagi said she loves everyone from around here so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They're all really nice and friendly...
And, well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Comforting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's exactly it!
How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. The photos with you and Nagi made me think that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, there was a point where your mom stopped showing up in these photos.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that was probably when she started going back to work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No one was usually home back then, so I was usually with Aunt Nagi and everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looking back, I guess I wanted my dad and Aunt Nagi to pay more attention to me since it was so lonely not always having my mom around.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I haven't felt lonely at all since that time I decided to run away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got to know how Aunt Nagi and my dad really felt about me, and...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Good luck with practice today, An!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: I love the way you sing, An♪

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: I have a song that I'd like to recommend. Would you like to hear it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know that I have everyone from around town on my side....

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So as long as I'm here, I'll never be alone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This really is a wonderful city.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now I totally get why Aunt Nagi said she'd never get tired of this place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I want you to keep loving this city too, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I will. I love this city a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because it's where I met you and got into street music. This place means so much to me now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: K-Koohaanee...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wah! A-An!
You always throw yourself at me like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because what you said made me so happy.
